common_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one full-body 2D game NPC sprite for Yautja: La Longue Chasse. Create exactly ONE new BOTANIST of the Veilleurs / dark jungle tribe. First image is ROLE/CULTURE reference: restrained navy-indigo cloth and blue-black steel protection/biomask, slate/grey scales, practical botanical sample containers with tiny cyan-violet bioluminescent plants, field tools. Second image is RENDER/CAMERA style reference ONLY: realistic handpainted 2D, slightly elevated three-quarter camera facing right. Do not copy its characters. Unique alien face or biomask, body silhouette, dreadlock arrangement, garment cut and gear placement specified below. Unmasked heads have ridged Yautja skull and four alien mandibles, never human or elf faces; scaled hide, clawed hands/feet. All are adults, fully clothed modest functional naturalist garments, no sexualization, no elite warrior weapons. Attached or hand-held objects only; plant specimens are SMALL contained study samples, not scenery. Exactly one humanoid, no sheets or duplicate figures. True transparent alpha, no background, cast shadow, floor, haze, halo, labels, writing, watermark. Whole body and every tool entirely within frame, pulled back camera, leave at least8% completely empty margin on all four sides, figure at most80% canvas height.

designs.name: Luminous frond collector
designs.design: Stout mature male with a broad flattened navy-steel biomask, squared cheek plates and a short central air-filter slit; thick dreadlocks gathered in a low knot. Indigo sleeveless field coat with asymmetrical grey-blue shoulder armor, dark covered legs and strapped knee guards. Left forearm cradles a short cylindrical glass specimen canister containing ONE violet fern with subtle cyan tips; right hand carries a small closed probe roll. Four tiny seed tubes on broad diagonal strap, oval canvas pouch at hip.

designs.name: Canopy seed keeper
designs.design: Tall lean adult female with an elongated blue-black mask with twin narrow swept side ridges and a recessed vertical mouth filter, long dreadlocks tied high in two cascading groups. Modest high-neck navy wrap tunic and split long tabard over solid dark leggings, light overlapping steel chest plates. Holds a flat hexagonal sealed seed case at waist in both hands; different miniature amber/cyan seed capsules in a woven belt, compact narrow sample backpack.

designs.name: Spore conservator
designs.design: Short broad elderly female unmasked alien Yautja with four mandibles, ash-speckled olive skin and wide wrinkled skull, short grey dreadlocks secured by dark silver rings. Fully clothed deep indigo apron over loose slate sleeves and trousers, short shoulder shawl, leather glove wraps. Carries a small sealed round glass spore capsule with three purple mushroom caps inside, and a capped pipette in other hand. Padded spherical sample pouches at hips, no loose spores.

designs.name: Root ecologist
designs.design: Very tall muscular male with an angular navy-steel biomask, deep black triangular eyes and two asymmetrical short side vents, dreadlocks bundled behind each side of head. Blue charcoal split field coat over protective woven vest and brown underlayers, broad right pauldron, simple shin armor. Holds a slim vertical transparent root chamber close against left ribs showing one white branching root system and tiny cyan leaves; free hand grips a capped blunt soil corer at thigh.

designs.name: Pollination researcher
designs.design: Small athletic adult female unmasked Yautja with copper-flecked blue-grey scales, narrow cranial crest and four visible mandibles, short tidy dreadlocks braided into three small groups. Navy short wrap jacket over modest solid slate undersuit, segmented blue apron panels and light forearm guards. Right hand raises a palm-sized closed magnifying scanner, left holds a small sealed square pollination sample box containing one violet bud. Two fitted seed cartridges across sternum and compact waist pouch.

designs.name: Botany elder
designs.design: Tall stooped elderly male with smooth elongated worn blue-steel biomask, narrow brow and ribbed lower filter, sparse white-tipped dreadlocks. Floor-free calf-length indigo split robe with high folded scarf and pale grey piping, light thin shoulder scales, sturdy wrapped boots exposing claws. Cradles a broad flat botanical specimen folder with rigid covers against chest; left hand holds a short glass seed tube. Several thin sample sleeves attached to belt, no readable writing.

designs.name: Night moss gardener
designs.design: Broad-shouldered adult female with rounded blue-black mask, short lateral cheek fins and luminous pale cyan eye slots, dreadlocks coiled into a wide low bun. Thick navy tunic with asymmetrical layered skirt over dark practical trousers, weathered blue ceramic knee plates. Holds a shallow sealed rectangular moss terrarium in both hands, with one low purple-blue moss cushion inside. Ribbed hip satchel, rolled fibre ties and blunt pruning scissors secured to belt.

designs.name: Jungle survey botanist
designs.design: Medium-height wiry male unmasked alien Yautja with grey green scales, sharply angled forehead ridges and short jaw mandibles, long dreadlocks high-tied into a rear crest. Split indigo long vest over slate-grey utility sleeves, diagonal blue armour harness and reinforced shin wraps. Right hand at chest strap, left carries a sturdy little three-chamber glass sample carrier with one tiny different seed in each chamber. Compact shoulder sensor and coiled retrieval cord at waist.

designs.name: Preservation attendant
designs.design: Short full-bodied mature female with a broad domed navy biomask, smooth cheeks and two small circular filter ports, shoulder-length thick dreadlocks in parallel cords. Long slate-blue padded vest over navy crossed tunic, modest covered trousers, brown belt with blue ceramic hooks. Both hands support a small lidded specimen bowl with a narrow glass viewing band revealing a dim violet leaf. Two quilted crescent sample pouches and sealed fluid bottle on belt.

designs.name: Plant anatomist
designs.design: Tall narrow-built adult male with long blue-steel biomask, raised central forehead ridge and short angular jaw, very long dreadlocks bound low. Full dark indigo leather laboratory field apron over covered grey sleeves and trousers, slim segmented gauntlets. Holds a sealed long narrow specimen slide box in left hand and blunt capped dissection probe in right. Six tiny glass vials across one hip and rounded glass-domed sample backpack, dim cyan plant fragment inside.

designs.name: Rhizome keeper
designs.design: Short powerful mature male unmasked alien Yautja, dark olive scale skin with silver spots, heavy squared cranium and four mandibles, dreadlocks wrapped into compact rear bun. Blue charcoal quilted vest with indigo cross-wrap shoulder mantle and knee-length split apron over slate trousers. Left arm hugs an oval sealed rhizome vessel with thick pale root bulb and two purple shoots; right hand rests on its strap. Cylindrical padded seed containers on wide utility belt.

designs.name: Rare bloom conservator
designs.design: Tall slender mature female with streamlined blue biomask, small stepped brow plates and offset vertical filter, fine dreadlocks tied into a long single central cascade. Indigo asymmetrical robe over modest dark trousers, pale slate folded collar and slim steel shoulder pieces. Holds a small upright glass bulb-shaped canister showing ONE violet closed alien flower; other hand carries a tiny sealed sample wallet. Triangular tool pouch and two pale blue seed capsules on belt.

designs.name: Expedition botanist
designs.design: Huge robust adult male with square broad navy mask, four shallow parallel forehead grooves and sturdy angular cheeks, short thick dreadlocks held by wide dark strap. Rugged indigo divided coat over grey blue protective vest, ample brown canvas side pockets and heavy blue knee plates. Both hands carry a closed rectangular field specimen trunk by its handle; a tiny integrated viewing window reveals violet leaves. Large rolled-weather-cover backpack and soil tubes secured along one side.

designs.name: Fungal archive researcher
designs.design: Average-height elderly female unmasked Yautja, pale sage scales and delicate four mandibles under broad furrowed brow, thin long grey dreadlocks in one tail. High-collared slate-blue tabard over navy sleeved underlayers and dark trousers, simple small steel left shoulder plate. Studies a palm-sized closed circular spore scanner in left hand, right hand across opposite forearm. Flat sample cases at belt and narrow collection catalogue wallet, no text.

designs.name: Sap diagnostician
designs.design: Tall angular young adult male with triangular blue-steel mask, flattened high central crest, narrow cyan eye recesses and two lower filters, swept-back thin dreadlocks in three hanging groups. Navy sleeveless outer coat over modest fully covered grey undersuit, indigo segmented working apron and brown strap harness. Right hand holds a small capped sap probe connected by short cable to a compact reader in left hand. Three microvials of subtle purple liquid on left hip, no syringe aimed at anyone.

designs.name: Seedling transporter
designs.design: Broad athletic female with wide rounded navy mask, one enlarged protective cheek panel and small cyan optical sensor; dreadlocks in two thick low tails. Indigo field smock over slate sleeves and trousers, short layered wrap apron, soft protective forearm guards. Holds a small cylindrical clear nursery capsule with ONE compact cyan-tipped violet seedling in left hand while right grips the carrying strap. Two folded protective cloths attached to a wide sample satchel.

designs.name: Wandering botanist
designs.design: Lean elderly male unmasked Yautja with pale grey speckled skin, elongated alien skull and long mandibles, uneven grey shoulder-length dreadlocks. Navy hood folded behind head, calf-length slate and indigo split traveling coat, fully covered brown utility trousers and light blue metal shoulder strip. Left carries a closed oval specimen case with small glass window showing ONE dark violet seed pod, right grips crescent satchel strap. Folded soil scoop secured at belt.

designs.name: Juvenile plant specialist adult
designs.design: Small slim young adult female with a compact blue-black biomask, narrow dome and plain straight mouth filter, short neat dreadlocks gathered behind both ears. Simple modest indigo crossover tunic over solid slate sleeves and dark trousers, narrow brown belt and light knee wraps. Holds a closed square padded propagation tray at abdomen, small round glass window showing two tiny cyan sprouts. Three different cloth pouches and capped miniature probe on belt.

designs.name: Specimen preparation chief
designs.design: Barrel-chested mature male with broad layered blue-steel biomask featuring high flattened central fin, two compact side vents and black eyes, long thick dreadlocks tied in low fan. Wide indigo rubberized work apron over modest dark-blue tunic and grey leggings, sturdy steel arm guards. Left forearm supports a short cylindrical sealed specimen drum with two flat violet leaves inside; right hand holds blunt sample tongs folded closed. Angular tool boxes and clean wrapping cloth clipped to harness.

designs.name: Veilleurs community botanist
designs.design: Medium-height mature female unmasked Yautja with pale grey and muted olive scales, broad graceful alien brow and four mandibles, long dreadlocks arranged in a low horizontal loop. High-neck navy sleeveless outer robe over slate sleeves, layered split skirt over solid brown leggings, one small blue shoulder mantle. Left hand holds a tiny sealed bulb vessel with one luminous purple bud at chest height, right rests on sample belt. Three small seed cases and a rounded side pouch.
